title: Oceanographer says the objects are undersea or subterranean
summary: Harold Malmgren tells of Oceanographer says the objects are undersea or subterranean, about 2025 at oceans / subterranean, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: But then we have one revelation by the oceanographer last few days who says they are not China, they are not US.

plain: Harald Malmgren, a former advisor to US presidents, says that in 2025 an unnamed oceanographer, a scientist who studies the sea, came out and said the mysterious objects are neither Chinese nor American. Malmgren presents this as a revelation pointing to the objects living under the sea or underground, which would mean something non-human sharing the planet with us.
